# extractSheetNameFromA1Notation

<link-summary>Takes the sheet name out of an A1 notation.</link-summary>

<web-summary>extractSheetNameFromA1Notation() — Takes the sheet name out of an A1 notation. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.6.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function extractSheetNameFromA1Notation(a1Notation: string): string | null;
```

The quoting Sheets uses for names with spaces or punctuation is undone, so `"'My Sheet'!A1"` yields `My Sheet`. A notation without a sheet name yields nothing.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type     | Description           |
| :----------- | :------- | :-------------------- |
| `a1Notation` | `string` | The notation to read. |

## Returns

`string | null` — the sheet name, when the notation carries one.

## Examples

### Extracting

```javascript
extractSheetNameFromA1Notation("Sheet1!A1:B2"); // => "Sheet1"
```
